title: AutoCode: 48 agent skills from a spoken request to a deployed URL
description: AutoCode is a skill pack that takes a plain-language request through building, testing and deployment in a single session and returns a live URL. It ships 48 skills with no dependencies, installs into Claude Code, Codex, Hermes, Cursor and Gemini, uses the iLang v5.0 judgment layer to decide when to stop and ask, and keeps deployment secrets out of the model context.
